test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A thief steals a bike at 12.40 p.m. and drives it at 45 km/h. The theft is discovered at 1 p.m. and the owner sets off in a car at 65 km/h in the direction the thief was heading. The time at which the owner can catch the thief is:
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of Thief = 45 km/h

Theif discovered at 1:00 pm

Speed of Owner = 65 km/h

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance / Time taken

**Solution:**

Relative speed = 65 - 45 = 20 km/h

In one hour the thief will cover 45 km.

In 20 minutes ( 12:40 PM to 1:00 PM) he will cover = 45 × 20/60 = 15 km

Now, the owner will reach theif in = (15 / 20) = 3/4 hours = 3/4 x 60 minutes = 45 minutes.

So, 1:00 PM + 45 minutes = 1:45 PM

**Hence, the owner will catch the thief at 1:45 PM.**
